author: nickyeow

english.text: May I eat a little of it?

jyutping: ngo5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 sik6 siu2 siu2 aa3？
text: 我可唔可以食少少呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: It is dangerous to swim here.

jyutping: ni1 dou6 jau4 seoi2 hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3。
text: 呢度游水好危險㗎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Enjoy yourself!

jyutping: wun6 dak1 hoi1 sam1 di1 laa3！
text: 玩得開心啲喇！

author: nickyeow

english.text: What were you doing when I called you yesterday?

jyutping: cam4 jat6 ngo5 daa2 din6 waa2 lai4 go2 zan6，nei5 hai2 dou6 zou6 gan2 di1 me1 aa3？
text: 尋日我打電話嚟嗰陣，你喺度做緊啲咩呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: You should eat something before you go.

jyutping: nei5 jing1 goi1 sik6 di1 je5 sin1 zau2。
text: 你應該食啲嘢先走。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Give this ticket to whoever comes first.

jyutping: bin1 go3 dai6 jat1 go3 lai4，zau6 bei2 ni1 zoeng1 fei1 keoi5。
text: 邊個第一個嚟，就俾呢張飛佢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: What color do you think she likes?

jyutping: nei5 waa6 keoi5 zung1 ji3 di1 me1 ngaan4 sik1 aa1 naa4？
text: 你話佢鍾意啲咩顏色吖嗱？

author: nickyeow

english.text: He sometimes forgets to take books back to the library.

jyutping: keoi5 jau5 si4 wui5 m4 gei3 dak1 zoeng1 di1 syu1 waan4 faan1 heoi3 tou4 syu1 gun2。
text: 佢有時會唔記得將啲書還返去圖書館。

author: fercheung

english.text: You have to study harder.

jyutping: nei5 jiu3 bei2 do1 di1 sam1 gei1 hok6 zaap6 laa3。
text: 你要俾多啲心機學習喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Are they able to read these words?

jyutping: keoi5 dei6 sik1 m4 sik1 duk6 ne1 gei2 zek3 zi6 aa3？
text: 佢哋識唔識讀呢幾隻字呀？

author: kaenif

english.text: Did you see a brown wallet around here?

jyutping: nei5 jau5 mou5 hai2 fu6 gan6 gin3 gwo3 jat1 go3 fe1 sik1 ngan4 baau1？
text: 你有冇喺附近見過一個啡色銀包？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I don't know what he's doing now, but it's not her.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 ji4 gaa1 gaau2 gan2 me1，daan6 jat1 ding6 m4 hai6 gaau2 gan2 keoi5 lo1。
text: 我唔知佢而家搞緊咩，但一定唔係搞緊佢囉。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm definitely going to give up smoking!

jyutping: ngo5 jat1 ding6 wui5 gaai3 jin1！
text: 我一定會戒煙！

author: nickyeow

english.text: Can you read sheet music?

jyutping: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 tai2 ng5 sin3 pou2 gaa3？
text: 你識唔識睇五線譜㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Can't you be a little more patient?

jyutping: nei5 bei2 siu2 siu2 noi6 sing3 dak1 m4 dak1 zek1？
text: 你俾少少耐性得唔得唧？

author: nickyeow

english.text: No one would help me.

jyutping: mou5 jan4 bong1 ngo5。
text: 冇人幫我。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Layla went to bed early.

jyutping: leoi5 laai1 hou2 zou2 zau6 zau2 zo2 heoi3 fan3。
text: 蕾拉好早就走咗去瞓。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He called the judge 'Your Majesty'.

jyutping: keoi5 giu3 co3 zo2 go3 faat3 gun1 zou6「faat3 gun1 bai6 haa6」。
text: 佢叫錯咗個法官做「法官陛下」。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I wouldn't wish it on my worst enemy.

jyutping: zau6 syun3 ngo5 gei2 gam3 zang1 jat1 go3 jan4，ngo5 dou1 m4 wui5 soeng2 keoi5 sau6 gam3 ge3 fu2。
text: 就算我幾咁憎一個人，我都唔會想佢受咁嘅苦。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Somebody's following us.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 bei2 jan4 gan1 zung1 gan2。
text: 我哋俾人跟蹤緊。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I don't think the pool will be open this weekend.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 gok3 dak1 wing6 ci4 gam1 go3 lai5 baai3 wui5 hoi1 lo1。
text: 我唔覺得泳池今個禮拜會開囉。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Sometimes, in a bilingual or multilingual family, children speak to parents in Language A, and parents speak to their children in Language B, and they inter-comprehend. Such is the case in my immigrant family from the Philippines, who, in North America, have us children speak English to parents, and parents speak to us children in Tagalog. I am able to speak to other Filipinos in Tagalog. It has just become customary in my family to have the complex linguistic situation.

jyutping: jau5 si4，hai2 soeng1 jyu5 waak6 do1 jyu5 gaa1 ting4 jap6 min6，siu2 pang4 jau5 jung6 gaap3 jyu5 jin4 tung4 fu6 mou5 gong2 je5，ji4 fu6 mou5 jung6 jyut3 jyu5 jin4 tung4 keoi5 dei6 ge3 siu2 pang4 jau5 gong2 je5，ji4 keoi5 dei6 wu6 soeng1 lei5 gaai2。ngo5 lei4 zi6 fei1 leot6 ban1 ge3 ji4 man4 gaa1 ting4 zau6 hai6 gam2 ge3 cing4 fong3，hai2 bak1 mei5，keoi5 dei6 wui5 bei2 ngo5 dei6 di1 siu2 pang4 jau5 tung4 fu6 mou5 gong2 jing1 man2，ji4 fu6 mou5 zau6 jung6 taap3 gaa1 lok3 man2 tung4 ngo5 dei6 di1 siu2 pang4 jau5 gong2 je5，ngo5 ho2 ji5 jung6 taap3 gaa1 lok3 man2 tung4 kei4 taa1 fei1 leot6 ban1 jan4 gong2 je5。ngo5 uk1 kei2 ngaam1 ngaam1 sing4 wai4 zaap6 gwaan3，jau5 fuk1 zaap6 ge3 jyu5 jin4 cing4 fong3。
text: 有時，喺雙語或多語家庭入面，小朋友用甲語言同父母講嘢，而父母用乙語言同佢哋嘅小朋友講嘢，而佢哋互相理解。我嚟自菲律賓嘅移民家庭就係噉嘅情況，喺北美，佢哋會畀我哋啲小朋友同父母講英文，而父母就用塔加洛文同我哋啲小朋友講嘢，我可以用塔加洛文同其他菲律賓人講嘢。我屋企啱啱成為習慣，有複雜嘅語言情況。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: But Cicero does not seem even to have had a religious sentiment to cover the nakedness of his political opportunism. Not only does he in the Tusculan Disputations put aside in the Platonic fashion all the Homeric tales which anthropomorphize and discredit the gods; but in his treatise On Divination he shows an absolute disbelief in all the recognized practices, including the augury which he himself officially practised; and his sole excuse is that they are to be retained “on account of popular opinion and of their great public utility.”

jyutping: daan6 sai1 sak1 lo4 ci5 fu4 lin4 zung1 gaau3 cing4 seoi5 dou1 mou5，ho2 ji5 ze1 goi3 keoi5 ge3 zing3 zi6 gei1 wui6 zyu2 ji6 ge3 lo2 lou6。keoi5 m4 daan1 zi2 hai2《tou4 si1 fu3 laan4 zang1 ji5》jap6 min6 ji5 baak3 laai1 tou4 sik1 ge3 fong1 sik1 zoeng1 so2 jau5 zoeng1 so2 jau5 zoeng1 san4 ji5 jan4 faa3 tung4 mut3 hak1 ge3 ho4 maa5 gu3 si6 fong3 maai4 jat1 bin1；daan6 hai6 hai2 keoi5 ge3《zim1 buk1 leon6》jap6 min6，keoi5 biu2 jin6 ceot1 deoi3 so2 jau5 gung1 jing6 ge3 zou6 faat3 ge3 zyut6 deoi3 m4 seon3 jam6，baau1 kut3 keoi5 zi6 gei2 zing3 sik1 sat6 cin5 ge3 zim1 buk1；ji4 keoi5 wai4 jat1 ge3 zik6 hau2 hai6「jan1 wai6 man4 ji3 tung4 keoi5 dei6 ge3 geoi6 daai6 gung1 gung6 jung6 tou4」ji4 bou2 lau4 ni1 di1 zou6 faat3。
text: 但西塞羅似乎連宗教情緒都冇，可以遮蓋佢嘅政治機會主義嘅裸露。佢唔單止喺《圖斯庫蘭爭議》入面以柏拉圖式嘅方式將所有將所有將神擬人化同抹黑嘅荷馬故事放埋一邊；但係喺佢嘅《占卜論》入面，佢表現出對所有公認嘅做法嘅絕對唔信任，包括佢自己正式實踐嘅占卜；而佢唯一嘅藉口係「因為民意同佢哋嘅巨大公共用途」而保留呢啲做法。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: When the Second Men had remained in their strange racial trance for about thirty million years, the obscure forces that make for advancement began to stir in them once more. This reawakening was favoured by geological accident. An incursion of the sea gradually isolated some of their number in an island continent, which was once part of the North Atlantic ocean-bed. The climate of this island gradually cooled from subtropical to temperate and sub-arctic.

jyutping: dong1 dai6 ji6 go3 jan4 hai2 keoi5 dei6 kei4 gwaai3 ge3 zung2 zuk6 fong2 fat1 zong6 taai3 daai6 joek3 saam1 cin1 maan6 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6，ling6 dou3 keoi5 dei6 zeon3 bou6 ge3 mou4 wu4 lik6 loeng6 hoi1 ci2 zoi3 ci3 hai2 keoi5 dei6 san1 soeng6 gaau2 dung6。ni1 go3 cung4 san1 gok3 sing2 hai6 sau6 dou3 dei6 zat1 ji3 ngoi6 ge3 jing2 hoeng2。hoi2 joeng4 ge3 jap6 cam1 zuk6 zim6 zoeng1 keoi5 dei6 ge3 bou6 fan6 jan4 gaak3 lei4 hai2 jat1 go3 dou2 zeoi6 daai6 luk6，ni1 go3 daai6 luk6 cang4 ging1 hai6 bak1 daai6 sai1 joeng4 hoi2 cong4 ge3 jat1 bou6 fan6。ni1 go3 dou2 ge3 hei3 hau6 jau4 aa3 jit6 daai3 zuk6 zim6 bin3 laang5，bin3 sing4 wan1 daai3 tung4 aa3 bak1 gik6。
text: 當第二個人喺佢哋奇怪嘅種族恍惚狀態大約三千萬年嘅時候，令到佢哋進步嘅模糊力量開始再次喺佢哋身上攪動。呢個重新覺醒係受到地質意外嘅影響。海洋嘅入侵逐漸將佢哋嘅部分人隔離喺一個島嶼大陸，呢個大陸曾經係北大西洋海床嘅一部分。呢個島嘅氣候由亞熱帶逐漸變冷，變成溫帶同亞北極。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Emperor Qin Shi Huang and Emperor Wu of Han, though remarkable in their achievements, somewhat lacked in literary grace; Emperor Taizong of Tang and Emperor Taizu of Song, though commendable in their elegance, still fall slightly short in their brilliance. The proud conqueror, Genghis Khan, knew only how to bend the bow and shoot great eagles. All of them are now bygone, and if you want to count the truly remarkable figures, look to the present age.

jyutping: ceon4 ci2 wong4 tung4 hon3 mou5 dai3，seoi1 jin4 keoi5 dei6 ge3 sing4 zau6 fei1 soeng4 ceot1 sik1，daan6 hai6 hai2 man4 hok6 soeng6 jau5 so2 him3 kyut3；tong4 taai3 zung1 tung4 sung3 taai3 zou2，seoi1 jin4 keoi5 dei6 ge3 jau1 ngaa5 zik6 dak1 zaan3 soeng2，daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 fai1 wong4 jing4 jin4 loek6 jim4 lok6 hau6。giu1 ngou6 ge3 zing1 fuk6 ze2 sing4 gat1 si1 hon4，zi2 hai6 sik1 dak1 waan1 gung1 se6 daai6 jing1。keoi5 dei6 cyun4 bou6 dou1 ji5 ging1 gwo3 heoi3 zo2，jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 sou2 di1 zan1 zing3 zik6 dak1 lau4 ji3 ge3 jan4 mat6，zau6 jiu3 tai2 haa2 jin6 gam1 ge3 nin4 doi6。
text: 秦始皇同漢武帝，雖然佢哋嘅成就非常出色，但係喺文學上有所欠缺；唐太宗同宋太祖，雖然佢哋嘅優雅值得讚賞，但係佢哋嘅輝煌仍然略嫌落後。驕傲嘅征服者成吉思汗，只係識得彎弓射大鷹。佢哋全部都已經過去咗，如果你想數啲真正值得留意嘅人物，就要睇吓現今嘅年代。
